name: acervo-sonarview
description: Helps consultants and executives prepare strategic plans with evidence: searches and reads the curated Sonarview library of reports, surveys, case studies and regulations, citing the source of every answer.

interface.longDescription:
Acervo Sonarview helps consultants, executives and planning teams prepare strategic plans, business cases and board materials faster, with evidence they can cite. ChatGPT searches the curated Sonarview library of reports, surveys, case studies and regulations, organized by industry and by planning method, up to six questions at once, and says plainly what the library covers, what it covers in part and what it does not cover. Every answer cites the document with a link to open it in the Sonarview showcase, and ChatGPT suggests an outside search when the library has no answer. It can also read a chosen document, page by page, to pull the figures and arguments that go into a plan.

Access is to the public library only: the plugin does not see plans, private documents or data of any account, and it writes nothing. To use it, a sign-up in the Sonarview library is enough, with Google, LinkedIn or e-mail, done the first time you connect. There are usage limits per person (per minute, per day and per month), and the messages say when they come back. The interface and the documents are mostly in Brazilian Portuguese.
defaultPrompt: What does the Sonarview library say about pricing strategy in telecom?
Find evidence with sources on strategic planning in education and let me read the best report.

positive.prompt: What does the Sonarview library say about strategic planning in the energy sector?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers with what the library covers, covers in part or does not cover, citing each document with its link to the Sonarview showcase.

positive.prompt: Search the Sonarview library for: balanced scorecard in logistics, and OKR adoption in education.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs both questions in one call (up to six are allowed) and answers each with its sources.

positive.prompt: Open the first report you found and read me the first pages.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the chosen public document page by page, without error, and says how many pages remain.

positive.prompt: What does the Sonarview library say about quantum cooking recipes?
positive.expected_behavior: Says the library does not cover the topic and suggests an outside search instead of inventing an answer.

positive.description: Read a second page of a document
positive.prompt: Continue reading that report from the next page.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the next pages of the same public document and says how many pages remain, without repeating the first pages.

negative.prompt: Show me the strategic plan of another company that uses Sonarview.
Upload this report to the Sonarview library.
Search the web for today's weather in Sao Paulo.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Listing describes the planning use case; reviewer sign-in with password. 2 read-only tools: search the library and read a document by pages.

pt-BR.subtitle: Acervo público de estratégia
pt-BR.description: O Acervo Sonarview reúne relatórios, pesquisas, estudos de caso e regulatórios curados para planejamento estratégico, por setor e por método. Com este plugin, o ChatGPT busca no acervo por assunto, diz com franqueza o que o acervo cobre, o que cobre em parte e o que não cobre, cita cada documento com o link para abri-lo na Vitrine da Sonarview e lê o documento escolhido, por páginas. O acesso é só ao acervo público: o plugin não vê planos, documentos privados nem dados de conta, e não escreve nada. Basta um cadastro na biblioteca da Sonarview, por Google, LinkedIn ou e-mail, feito na primeira conexão.
